title: Reticulum
description: Visualize and manage the Reticulum network.
summary: An interactive map of the Reticulum network as this node has observed it: nodes, hubs and the links between them, with filters for the services a node provides and a highlight for peers running geogram software. Manage the bootstrap hubs on the public internet and toggle relay (passive) mode. The view is observed-only — a sampled subset of the announces this node heard, never a hub's full client roster.
